## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
setwd("~/Desktop/Szade_Lab/aktualne")
```

```{r}
cyto_cols <- c(
  "all_events",
  "singlets_cells",
  "Live_dead_Ly6C_subset",
  "cKit_neg",
  "low6c_mono",
  "monocytes_1",
  "neutrophils",
  "non_mielo",
  "FcR_neg",
  "CD150neg_CD105pos",
  "CD150pos_CD105pos",
  "CD150pos_CD105neg",
  "CD150neg_CD105neg",
  "cKit_pos",
  "GMP",
  "non_GMP",
  "CFU_E",
  "CMP",
  "preCFUE",
  "preGM",
  "preMegE",
  "trombo"
)

# wczytanie danych
df <- read_excel("ERC_aim1_exp15_summary.xlsx") 

# OBIEKT R z samą cytometrią
df_cyto <- df %>%
  select(all_of(cyto_cols))

# normalizacja % of live dla wszystkich
denom <- "Live_dead_Ly6C_subset"
gate_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df_cyto), denom)

df_cyto_pct_live <- df_cyto %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(gate_cols),
      ~ ifelse(.data[[denom]] == 0 | is.na(.data[[denom]]), NA_real_, (.x / .data[[denom]]) * 100),
      .names = "{.col}_pct_live"
    )
  )

#normalizacja % of live dla zgatowanych populacji
gated_populations <- c(
  "cKit_neg",
  "low6c_mono",
  "monocytes_1",
  "neutrophils",
  "non_mielo",
  "FcR_neg",
  "CD150neg_CD105pos",
  "CD150pos_CD105pos",
  "CD150pos_CD105neg",
  "CD150neg_CD105neg",
  "cKit_pos",
  "GMP",
  "non_GMP",
  "CFU_E",
  "CMP",
  "preCFUE",
  "preGM",
  "preMegE",
  "trombo"
)

denom <- "Live_dead_Ly6C_subset"
df_gated_pct_live <- df_cyto %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(gated_populations),
      ~ ifelse(
        .data[[denom]] == 0 | is.na(.data[[denom]]),
        NA_real_,
        (.x / .data[[denom]]) * 100
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_pct_live"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(ends_with("_pct_live"))
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# 1. NA -> 0
pca_df <- df_gated_pct_live %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))

# usuwamy kolumny o zerowej wariancji
zero_var_cols <- pca_df %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ var(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "col", values_to = "var") %>%
  filter(is.na(var) | var == 0) %>%
  pull(col)

zero_var_cols

pca_df_filtered <- pca_df %>%
  select(-all_of(zero_var_cols))

# macierz do PCA
pca_mat <- as.matrix(pca_df_filtered)

# PCA bez log-transform
pca_res <- prcomp(
  pca_mat,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

# procent wariancji wyjaśnionej
var_explained <- (pca_res$sdev^2) / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)
var_explained_percent <- var_explained * 100

var_explained_percent
cumsum(var_explained_percent)
```

Bierzemy pierwsze 6 PC\
PC6 → 80.70%

```{r}
# 3. bierzemy pierwsze 6 PC
pca_data <- pca_res$x[, 1:6, drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
library(uwot)
# UMAP
umap_res <- uwot::umap(pca_data)

# do ramki danych
umap_df <- data.frame(
  UMAP1 = umap_res[,1],
  UMAP2 = umap_res[,2]
)

head(umap_df)
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Chcę zrobić teraz DBSCAN i wybrać odpowiedni parametr eps, więc zastosuje metodę elbow:

```{r}
library(dbscan)

kNNdistplot(umap_res, k = 5)
abline(h = 0.5, col = "red", lty = 2)
```

```{r}
library(dbscan)

db <- dbscan(umap_res, eps = 0.35, minPts = 5) # wybrane z wykresu elbow powyżej!!!

umap_df$cluster <- as.factor(db$cluster)

ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Co jest w klastrach?

```{r}
umap_df$cluster <- as.factor(db$cluster)

df_clusters <- df_gated_pct_live %>%
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(db$cluster))

table(df_clusters$cluster)

cluster_summary <- df_clusters %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

df_clusters %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sd, na.rm = TRUE))
```

Shannon Index

```{r}
shannon_index <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]              
  p <- x / sum(x)         
  -sum(p * log(p))
}

df_clusters$shannon <- apply(
  df_gated_pct_live,
  1,
  shannon_index
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(df_clusters, aes(x = cluster, y = shannon, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Shannon diversity per cluster")
```

```{r}
kruskal.test(shannon ~ cluster, data = df_clusters)
```

```{r}
df_clusters %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(mean_shannon = mean(shannon))
```

Profil fenotypowy klastra

```{r}
df_clusters <- df_gated_pct_live %>%
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(db$cluster))

cluster_means <- df_clusters %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
library(tibble)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)

# macierz średnich dla klastrów
cluster_profile <- cluster_means %>%
  column_to_rownames("cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

# globalne średnie i SD liczone na tych samych kolumnach
global_mean <- colMeans(df_gated_pct_live, na.rm = TRUE)
global_sd   <- apply(df_gated_pct_live, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

# sprawdzamy kolumny problematyczne
bad_cols <- names(global_sd[is.na(global_sd) | global_sd == 0 | is.infinite(global_sd)])
bad_cols

library(tibble)
library(dplyr)

cluster_profile <- cluster_means %>%
  column_to_rownames("cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

global_mean <- colMeans(df_gated_pct_live, na.rm = TRUE)
global_sd   <- apply(df_gated_pct_live, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

bad_cols <- names(global_sd[is.na(global_sd) | global_sd == 0 | is.infinite(global_sd)])
bad_cols

good_cols <- setdiff(colnames(cluster_profile), bad_cols)

cluster_profile <- cluster_profile[, good_cols, drop = FALSE]
global_mean <- global_mean[good_cols]
global_sd <- global_sd[good_cols]

cluster_profile_z <- sweep(cluster_profile, 2, global_mean, "-")
cluster_profile_z <- sweep(cluster_profile_z, 2, global_sd, "/")

sum(!is.finite(cluster_profile_z))
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

pheatmap(
  cluster_profile_z,
  scale = "none",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  main = "Phenotypic profile of clusters (z-score)"
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

cluster_long <- as.data.frame(cluster_profile_z) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cluster") %>%
  pivot_longer(-cluster, names_to = "feature", values_to = "z")

# top 5 ↑ i ↓ dla każdego klastra
top_features <- cluster_long %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(z)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  bind_rows(
    cluster_long %>%
      group_by(cluster) %>%
      arrange(z) %>%
      slice_head(n = 5)
  )
```

# **Subclustering - cluster 1**

```{r}
# próbki należące do klastra 1 z oryginalnego DBSCAN
idx_cl1 <- which(umap_df$cluster == "1")

# dane tylko dla klastra 1, ale nadal w oryginalnej przestrzeni UMAP
umap_cl1_original <- umap_res[idx_cl1, , drop = FALSE]

# dobór eps dla subklastrów
kNNdistplot(umap_cl1_original, k = 5)
abline(h = 0.3, col = "red", lty = 2)
```

```{r}
# subclustering wewnątrz klastra 1
db_sub_cl1 <- dbscan(
  umap_cl1_original,
  eps = 0.3,
  minPts = 5
)

# dodanie subklastrów do głównej ramki
umap_df$subcluster_cl1 <- NA
umap_df$subcluster_cl1[idx_cl1] <- as.factor(db_sub_cl1$cluster)
```

# **HEATMAP: clustering + subclustering!**

```{r}
# 1. Tworzymy wspólną etykietę: klastry + subklastry klastra 1
combined_labels <- umap_df %>%
  mutate(
    combined_cluster = ifelse(
      cluster == "1",
      paste0("cluster_1_sub_", subcluster_cl1),
      paste0("cluster_", cluster)
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(combined_cluster)

# 2. Dodajemy etykietę do danych cytometrycznych
df_combined_clusters <- df_gated_pct_live %>%
  mutate(combined_cluster = combined_labels)

# 3. Liczymy średnie wartości populacji cytometrycznych dla każdej grupy
combined_means <- df_combined_clusters %>%
  group_by(combined_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 4. Zamiana na macierz do heatmapy
combined_mat <- combined_means %>%
  column_to_rownames("combined_cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

# 5. Z-score względem wszystkich grup
# czyli dla każdej populacji patrzymy, które klastry/subklastry mają jej względnie dużo albo mało
combined_z <- scale(combined_mat)

# 6. Usunięcie kolumn, które mają same NA / brak zmienności
combined_z <- combined_z[, colSums(is.na(combined_z)) < nrow(combined_z), drop = FALSE]

# 7. Heatmapa
pheatmap(
  combined_z,
  scale = "none",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  fontsize_row = 11,
  angle_col = 90,
  main = "Phenotypic profile: clusters + subclusters of cluster 1 (z-score)"
)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(tibble)

# macierz średnich
heatmap_mat <- subcluster_means %>%
  column_to_rownames("subcluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

# bezpieczny z-score
zscore_safe <- function(x, mean, sd) {
  if (is.na(sd) || sd == 0) {
    return(rep(0, length(x)))
  } else {
    return((x - mean) / sd)
  }
}

heatmap_z <- apply(
  heatmap_mat,
  2,
  function(col) {
    zscore_safe(
      col,
      mean(col, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd(col, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
)

rownames(heatmap_z) <- rownames(heatmap_mat)

# upewniamy się, że nie ma NA/Inf
heatmap_z[is.na(heatmap_z)] <- 0
heatmap_z[is.infinite(heatmap_z)] <- 0

pheatmap(
  heatmap_z,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  fontsize_row = 12,
  angle_col = 90,
  main = "Z-score heatmap of mean cytometric populations across subclusters of cluster 1"
)
```

```{r}
zero_sd_cols <- names(
  which(apply(heatmap_mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
)

zero_sd_cols
```

# **UMAP –\> clusters + subclusters**

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Tworzymy wspólną etykietę: klastry + subklastry klastra 1
umap_df <- umap_df %>%
  mutate(
    combined_cluster = ifelse(
      cluster == "1",
      paste0("cluster_1_sub_", subcluster_cl1),
      paste0("cluster_", cluster)
    )
  )

# Zamiana na factor, żeby ggplot traktował to jako kategorie
umap_df$combined_cluster <- as.factor(umap_df$combined_cluster)

# UMAP: zwykłe klastry + subklastry klastra 1
ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = combined_cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "UMAP: clusters + subclusters of cluster 1",
    x = "UMAP1",
    y = "UMAP2",
    color = "Cluster / subcluster"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
